text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! There are so many spectators!
choice_data_list: It's a GⅠ race, after all.
It's a GⅠ race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai FS, where 
Logotype was competing. As one of the few 
Junior Class GⅠ races, the Hanshin 
Racecourse was buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I check the entrant info on my smartphone. 
Not many people seem to have high hopes 
for her. In fact, even among Trainers, she 
was considered a dark horse.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you looking at!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Hm!? Logo is 7th favorite?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I see... Still, I'm certain of it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: “—That today's victor will be Logotype!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—To be honest, I was half in doubt about 
Epiphaneia's confidence. After all, there 
was an undefeated Umamusume in the race as 
well. But—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She alone calmly deciphered the fiercely 
tangled development of the race. And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An upset by Logotype!! The winner is 
Logotype, yes it is!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooooh...?!" "Are you serious?!" "That 
undefeated girl just—" "Who's Logotype?" 
"Does this make her a top contender for 
the Classics?!"
choice_data_list:
(...She looks like she'll be a tough 
rival.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While sending applause to Logotype, I let 
my thoughts drift to next year's Classic 
races. Glancing at Epiphaneia beside me—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I wasn't thinking about anything at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Still... that logo is amazing. Really, 
truly amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I knew she was a strong Umamusume. But 
this is way beyond what I expected!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Logo!!!! Congratulations!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No! If it's my voice, she'll definitely 
hear it even from here!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Now is the winner's time! Let's watch as 
Logo receives all the praise she 
deserves!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!!!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. As expected, your voice really is 
loud.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Congrats once again, Logo!! I knew you'd 
win!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Yes, I won after all.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
It's Epi-san's turn next~. —Good luck in 
the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'll deliver a performance even 
better than what you showed me today!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll be looking forward to it~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Logotype's race seemed to fire 
Epiphaneia up even more. —The Hopeful 
Stakes is just around the corner.
